description: A broader synthetic profile for multi-pass retrieval with stronger audit expectations.
intended_use: Structured exploration of a research question across multiple generic source connector types.

notes: Require explicit uncertainty when evidence is mixed or incomplete.
Do not convert exploratory findings into professional advice.

audit_requirements: Record the active profile_id with each governed answer.
Record all connector types used during each iteration.
Preserve citation pointers, review flags, and limitations in exports.
Record skipped connectors and reason codes when available.
